# Send a priced, scoped proposal in 15 minutes, not an afternoon in Word.

> Free proposal generator for freelancers, consultants and small agencies: scope with included and excluded lists, phases with dates, fixed, good-better-best, hourly-with-cap or retainer pricing, deposit and milestones, change-order wording, acceptance block, print to PDF. No account, no watermark, works offline.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
